neighborhoods.name: Kenwood
neighborhoods.summary: Kenwood is a Minneapolis neighborhood between Lake of the Isles and Cedar Lake, known for its early-twentieth-century homes on winding, tree-lined streets.
neighborhoods.architecture: Kenwood's homes date mostly from the early 1900s, when the neighborhood grew into one of the city's most sought-after addresses. You'll find Colonial Revival, Tudor Revival, Prairie School and Arts and Crafts homes, many architect-designed, with original woodwork, leaded glass and generous porches. [Add notable architects and streets.]
neighborhoods.setting: Kenwood Park, the Kenwood Parkway and the shores of Lake of the Isles and Cedar Lake are all close by, along with the trails of the Chain of Lakes. [Add local landmarks and shops.]

neighborhoods.name: East Isles
neighborhoods.summary: East Isles is a Minneapolis neighborhood along the east shore of Lake of the Isles, known for its early-1900s homes near the lake and the shops of Uptown.
neighborhoods.architecture: Most East Isles homes were built in the early twentieth century, from large lakefront houses to Craftsman and period-revival homes on the blocks behind them. [Add notable architects, styles and streets.]
neighborhoods.setting: Lake of the Isles and its parkway and trails form the neighborhood's western edge, with the shops and restaurants of Uptown nearby. [Add local landmarks.]
neighborhoods.clip: Lake of the Isles shoreline at dusk

neighborhoods.name: East Harriet
neighborhoods.summary: East Harriet is a South Minneapolis neighborhood beside Lake Harriet, known for its early-twentieth-century homes and the Lyndale Park gardens.
neighborhoods.architecture: East Harriet's streets hold Craftsman bungalows, Tudor and Colonial Revival homes and foursquares, most from the first decades of the twentieth century. Becky has lived here herself, in a 1916 Craftsman. [Add notable streets and details.]
neighborhoods.setting: Lake Harriet, its bandshell and trails, and the rose and peace gardens of Lyndale Park are all close by. [Add local landmarks and shops.]
neighborhoods.clip: morning light through the Lyndale Park gardens

neighborhoods.name: Country Club
neighborhoods.summary: The Country Club District is an Edina neighborhood planned in the 1920s, known for its period-revival homes on tree-lined streets near 50th & France.
neighborhoods.architecture: The Country Club District was planned and built largely in the 1920s and 1930s, with Colonial Revival, Tudor Revival and other period-revival homes. Becky is restoring a 1928 Cape Cod here. [Add history, notable homes and any design guidelines.]
neighborhoods.setting: The shops and restaurants of 50th & France, Minnehaha Creek and nearby parks are all close by. [Add local landmarks.]
neighborhoods.clip: a tree-lined street of period-revival homes

neighborhoods.name: Summit Hill
neighborhoods.summary: Summit Hill is a St. Paul neighborhood along Summit and Grand Avenues, known for its Victorian-era and early-twentieth-century homes.
neighborhoods.architecture: Summit Hill holds some of the Twin Cities' finest Victorian and early-twentieth-century architecture, from grand homes on Summit Avenue to the smaller houses and rowhouses on the streets around it. [Add notable architects, homes and historic district details.]
neighborhoods.setting: Summit Avenue's boulevard and the shops and restaurants of Grand Avenue are at the heart of the neighborhood. [Add local landmarks.]

neighborhoods.name: Macalester-Groveland
neighborhoods.summary: Macalester-Groveland is a St. Paul neighborhood around Macalester College and Grand Avenue, known for its early-twentieth-century homes on tree-lined streets.
neighborhoods.architecture: Mac-Groveland's homes are mostly from the early twentieth century: Craftsman bungalows, foursquares, and Colonial and Tudor Revival homes. [Add notable streets and details.]
neighborhoods.setting: Grand Avenue's shops, the campuses of Macalester College and the University of St. Thomas, and the Mississippi River bluffs are all nearby. [Add local landmarks.]
